about.label: 05 / ABOUT
paragraphs: I started on the ground: pharma sales, automotive, logistics operations, and construction-materials distribution. That's where I learned business problems are rarely technology problems. They are usually process problems.

The path went from Excel dashboards and CRMs, to AppSheet and n8n, and now AI: a multi-channel messaging assistant, a video-production agent, and a brand-intelligence application. I work with n8n, the Google Gemini API, Telegram integrations, and Google Apps Script.
about.photoAlt: Portrait of Patrik Andryan seated on a folding chair in a denim jacket, looking to the side

practices.title: Grows in steps
practices.text: The messaging bot was rebuilt in phases and moved from spreadsheet-backed state to a relational database and cache.

practices.title: Guard rails
practices.text: Duplicate checks, merging of rapid-fire messages, rate limits, an internal-account filter, spam screening, and typing delays so replies feel human.

practices.title: Observable
practices.text: Error notifications, a health monitor every 15 minutes, and a daily report with AI analysis.

practices.title: Safe operations
practices.text: Workflows can be switched on or off from a web page by authorised people, with every action logged.
